title: Classic 350 Halcyon Green (Urban Carbon)
description: The Royal Enfield Classic 350 Halcyon Green (Urban Carbon) is combines low-slung road presence with generous low-end torque rumble, positioned in the Urban Roadster segment for riders demanding engaging everyday dynamics. Powered by a 350cc engine generating 44 HP and 38 Nm of torque against a curb weight of 163 kg, it delivers predictable, roll-on throttle response across its usable powerband. The cockpit is configured with an Upright Neutral riding stance and a balanced 790mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort, making daily city navigation as intuitive as weekend backroad escapes.
